$comment: Records in `modules::registry::ALL` whose submodule pin deliberately does
NOT sit on the tag their `version` names. See scripts/ci/check-module-pins.mjs.
An entry here is a claim that the drift is known and accepted, NOT a way to
silence the gate: `expect` pins the exact `git describe --tags` output, so a
record already exempt cannot drift FURTHER without failing. Widening the drift
is a deliberate edit to this file, which is a reviewable diff.
Delete an entry the moment the pins are reconciled. An exemption that has
stopped being true fails the gate too — `expect` must still match.

exemptions.reason: The main-branch TinyMCP submodule pin includes upstream changes after PR #30, while no matching tinymcp module release and digest have been published. Keep the registry artifact pinned to the verified v0.3.5 release and remove this exact source/artifact drift exemption when a matching release and digest are available.

The provider is published independently at v0.2.3 while the shared source pin is tinyruntime v0.2.7. v0.2.3 was built against tinyruntime 09f9646 (v0.2.4-5); git diff 09f9646..v0.2.7 changes no crate source (only CI, toolchain, versions, Cargo.lock and the tinybus pin), and the tinybus module ABI is revision 1 on both. Registry retains its matching published v0.2.3 provider artifact.

Registry retains its matching published v0.2.3 provider artifact.

The pin is v1.16.2 plus only the new pure-library crate tinymemory-conversations (tinymemory#170), which the core links as a Rust path dependency. No module, contract or bus source changes relative to v1.16.2, so the registry's v1.16.2 artifact still matches the contract compiled here. Remove when tinymemory#170 ships in a release and both pins move to it.

No module, contract or bus source changes relative to v0.1.8, so the registry's v0.1.8 artifact still matches the contract compiled here.
